limits: Keyword review is not an exhaustive legal classification.
Third-party SDK binaries, remote advertising, imported saves and future content are not certified.
Media needs separate visual review; raster text is not detected by this lexical script.

visualReview.scope: All drawable-nodpi PNG/WebP contact sheets, including old/new backgrounds, postcards, logos, items and generated headers. GIFs derive from these scenes with procedural leaves/snow particles.
visualReview.notes: Scenery, architecture, plants, animals and game reward items. No explicit adult imagery, hate or extremist iconography observed. Cultural/religious architecture is not treated as suspicious by itself.

audioReview.scope: tools/prepare_audio.py and packaged audio source note
audioReview.result: Original generated tones and ambient synthesis, no recorded speech or lyrics in the source generator.
